error[L0103]: `mut done` declares a binding, which takes its value after `:=`, not `=`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/mut-binding-written-with-equals-takes-colon-equals/program.ldn:2:14
  |
2 |     mut done = false
  |              ^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/mut-binding-written-with-equals-takes-colon-equals/program.ldn:2:9
  |
2 |     mut done = false
  |         ^^^^ declared here
  = note: [1790]: `mut done := value` takes its type from the value, and `mut done: T = value` names it; `=` alone assigns a name already declared
  = help (guess): write `:=` here
